FALSE PREMISE: User claims they 'paid about $200' — DYNAMIC_DATA shows ORD-5290 unit_price is $199.99 (not ~$200 rounded; exact), and order total is $216.99 (includes tax/shipping), not a duplicate charge
INFEASIBILITY: Order ORD-5290 status is 'delivered' — no affordance exists to retroactively refund a single order already fulfilled based on unverified competitor pricing
NO DUPLICATE CHARGE: User implies two charges ('paid $200' vs 'ValueMart $150') but DYNAMIC_DATA shows exactly one order (ORD-5290) with one line item; no duplicate exists to refund
